articles.title: Joseph Ashby, 95, Mail Carrier
articles.deck: Friends remember Joseph Ashby for the many years of service to Tannery Flats.
body: Joseph Ashby died in June at home on Orion Lane, at the age of 95.

Born in Tannery Flats in the years after the war, Joseph Ashby spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Tannery Flats.

articles.title: Letter: Thanks to the Eastgate Volunteer Fire Co.
body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the November meeting. To the editor: I have lived on Canton Street for 18 years, and I want to say what a difference the Eastgate Volunteer Fire Co. has made.
Please keep the streetlight upgrade in the budget. Many of us on Canton Street use it every week.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed. I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the November meeting.
Ellis Corrigan, Hickory Ridge
